answer: In an agent marketplace for managing a community garden, each identity must lock a fixed bond before bidding for work. Signed task receipts form an auditable thread; proven double billing forfeits the bond. Even at the zenith of demand, creating identities grants no free bidding capacity: an attacker running 1,000 identities must lock 1,000 bonds, tying up capital and risking its loss if those identities cheat.
